messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick sync — we got the all-clear from SRE. Need concise customer-facing updates: Status Page copy + email subject/body + a short social copy. Who can draft tone variants? @sam @jordan @eva

sam (SRE): Incident timeline: Degraded RPCs 09:58 UTC, rollback @10:30, service healthy @10:42. Root cause: faulty autoscale policy triggered a runaway batching path, we're investigating root cause and permanent fix. Monitoring ongoing.

jordan (Engineering Ops): Confirmed monitoring. Recommend statuspage progression: Investigating → Identified → Monitoring. Avoid definitive root cause language until postmortem.

mike (Legal): Agreed. Don't use "data loss" or "security incident" unless confirmed. Keep it factual and remediation-focused.

maria (Marketing): Okay — two tone options below. Pick one for the update and any edits. Want to send initial status page 'Identified' update now, email to affected customers in ~30m, public tweet only after Monitoring state. React with :thumbsup: for Option A, :heart: for Option B.

statusbot: Automated note: incident ticket #INC-4821 updated by sam. (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821)

Option A — empathetic (longer):

```
We experienced degraded inference performance impacting a subset of requests between 09:58–10:42 UTC. We rolled back a configuration change and traffic is healthy. We are monitoring validation and will post a follow-up when verification is complete. If you saw errors or increased latency, please contact support and include request IDs so we can investigate.
```

Option B — concise (short):

```
Service degradation affecting a subset of requests from 09:58–10:42 UTC. Rollback applied and systems are healthy. Monitoring continues; follow-up to come.
```

eva (Support): For the email, suggest subject: "Service update: performance incident resolved — action recommended". Body should include what to check and how to reach support. I'll draft the full email.

mike (Legal): Add line: "We have no indication of customer data impact at this time." only if verified; otherwise phrase carefully: "We have no indication of customer data exposure."

maria (Marketing): Draft email copy (first pass):

```
Subject: Service update — performance incident resolved

Hi —
We experienced a performance issue affecting some Redwood API requests between 09:58 and 10:42 UTC. A rollback resolved the immediate issue and systems are currently healthy. We are continuing validation and will share a full post-incident report within 72 hours.

If you observed errors or degraded latency, please reply with request IDs or open a support ticket: support@redwood.ai

Thanks for your patience —
The Redwood Inference team
```

jordan (Engineering Ops): For routing: mark affected customers with tag "incident-4821" in the CRM. Marketing, please hold the email until support confirms the impacted-account list (eva).

eva (Support): Working on the list now; should have it in ~20 minutes. I'll upload the CSV to the shared drive and ping here.

maria (Marketing): Timing recap: 1) Post Identified update to StatusPage now with Option B (concise). 2) Email to impacted accounts ~30m after CSV posted. 3) Tweet after we move to Monitoring. 4) Postmortem announcement + report within 72 hours. Any objections?

ashley (Product): +1 to timing and tone.
sam (SRE): +1
mike (Legal): +1 pending verification language

maria (Marketing): Great — I'll post the status update in 2 mins. Eva ping me when CSV is ready and I'll queue the email. Thanks everyone :rocket:
